notes.title: UPDATE 0.11.00
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45421515/c4deefc5c1de18e2f801a1867a31015a04f48a02.png[/img]🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️
Greetings to all lovers of ancient Greek weapons and regular updates!

We have two pieces of news for you:
[b]Good[/b]: Welcome the new update [b]0.11.00[/b]! This week we managed to:
* Add 3 new weapons.
* Add some new heroes.
* Fix a large number of errors and omissions.
* Especially for those who have completed the entire demo version, we have added a new arena. On it, the player will be able to experience all the implemented types of weapons and equipment, even if they are not revealed to him during the passage. The arena will only be open until the release of the full version of the game.

[b]Excellent[/b]: The process of working on the game has entered the final stage. This means that we have almost completed all planned mechanics, tasks and all main content. Now, we have a long process ahead of balancing, polishing and finalising all elements of the game. We are not yet ready to announce the final release date for the game, but we hope that this will happen no later than [b]autumn 2025[/b]!

Sincerely, the AHAPIKa team.

🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️

notes.title: Update 0.10.00
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45421515/744d8b8081f8efce4d2539e74b6c3653fb6e4499.png[/img]
🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️
Greetings to all fans of ancient Greek myths and computer games!


Almost a month and a half has passed since the last update of the demo. This does not mean that our team did not work on Ahapika. On the contrary, we have a lot of features. Some of them are already available in version 0.10.00! 

1. [b]The mysterious cave[/b]. In myths, heroes often descend into the realm of the dead. Unsurprisingly, our game also has a gloomy cave leading to the underworld of Hades. The levels with the new location are not available, but you can admire its interior in the arena, which opens after the fourth task.

2. [b]New heroes and weapons[/b]. There are new characters in the game. Try to guess them by their silhouettes in the House of Heroes. Only one additional character can be played in the demo, while the rest will be available in the full version. New weapons have also been added, one of which can be unlocked in the demo.

3. [b]Blueprints of charms[/b]. Blacksmith Sophus has found secret blueprints with which he creates unusual charms. As you probably know, Cyclopes turned everything around in his old forge, so he had to create new charms. Sophus now works in a new building under the protection of the agency's heroes. He promises to return all the coins for past saves so that you can buy charms with new abilities.

🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️

notes.title: UPDATE 0.09.00
notes.notes:
🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️
[b]Welcome olive lovers and connoisseurs of ancient Greek forges![/b]

We are pleased to share with you the latest news about the update 0.09.00 to our demo version of the game "AHAPIKA - Heroic Agency" . In this update, we focused on improving the interface design.

1) T[b]he Start menu[/b]. The background of the game launch has been slightly changed: an ancient city has turned into a large Greek city, with an elegant loading menu on the background.

2) [b]The Save window[/b]. In this window, we have added a lot of useful information about each saved game version. Previously, you could only see the level name, but now you can see full progress, number of open achievements, and time spent in game since last update.

3) [b]The Forge.[/b] The interior of this building at our heroes' agency has been completely redecorated. Its updated look will show the scope of the full game: you will be able to estimate the total number of storylines and the number of amulets within them.

4) [b]Fixed bugs[/b]. The programmer of our game fixed many bugs, including one that caused some players to be unable to download the demo version. If you encounter this issue, please let us know if the game will work after the update.
🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️
P.S. A careful player will notice another image in the current version of the game that was not present in the previous one. If you find something new and interesting, please share it in the comments below.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.07.00
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45421515/44ed9e375ef5066a7ef995bbf2dba0c225fc74c6.png[/img]
🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️
Greetings to the glorious heroes and brave heroines of ancient Greece! We are pleased to present you an update to the game "AGAPICA - heroic Agency" numbered 07/00.00, in which we have made many changes and additions, which, we hope, will make the game even more fun and exciting.

1) The Armory. The renovation of one of the agency's buildings has been completed, and we are proud to present you the new Armory building. Here, you can find all types of available weapons and equipment, learn about their history and the secrets of their use in combat.

2) A new weapon. Powerful nymphs generously share their power with the heroes of our agency. However, exactly how the hero will obtain a new weapon remains a mystery. The key thing is not to anger these divine beings, or they could turn the hero into a decaying tree stump.
3) Pause window. We have added a description of amulets used in combat. Now, you can always clarify their mechanisms of action. All weapon parameters for each level have also been added. In addition, it has become possible to see the talent of the hero performing feats during battle.

4) Storyground. We recently received a manuscript from Piarius describing the first feat of Hercules. He doesn't know about the Ampelaios Agency yet, but he's already embarked on the path of a true warrior and is trying to accomplish his first feat. The gods of Olympus are helping him with this. Unlike the heroes of the agency, Hercules isn't limited in his choice of weapons and equipment - all ammunition available in the game is at his disposal.
P.S. Even if you have completed all 10 levels of the demo, be sure to start from the very beginning on your journey. It's worth it!
🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️

notes.title: UPDATE 0.06.00
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45421515/adaed94331b201ac020ff90d1ded1cf8fab99d22.png[/img]

🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️
As part of a small update to the demo version of the game, a new building, the Temple of Valor, has opened in our agency courtyard. Now you can find out which achievements in the game have already been unlocked and which have yet to be unlocked.

There is a convenient filter in the upper right corner that allows you to view open weapons, equipment, and new heroes separately. The conditions for unlocking achievements remain hidden from the players, but their description, although rather confusing, can give you hints in which direction to move. However, displaying the progress for each achievement may provide a little more information on how to get closer to getting it. 

All open items and achievements will be transferred to the full version of the game, where you can collect a complete collection of uniforms and all the heroes.
🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️

Sincerely, the development team.
P.S. We hope that with each update the game becomes more high-quality and exciting.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.05.00
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45421515/6232db15f698079fd1a88c3c423728dc7e27eec7.png[/img]

🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️

Good evening, dear players! We are pleased to present you the update number 0.05.00.
 
Here's what we've added:
1) [b]Game hub[/b]. Our heroes have finally found their own house with a cozy courtyard. Some buildings are still undergoing renovation, but our agency is already ready to receive guests and perform heroic deeds.

2) [b]The talents of the heroes[/b]. Each character in our game has a unique character, strengths and weaknesses. Now we have added innate abilities to them, which will significantly affect your behavior in battle, depending on the chosen character. Explore them, combine them with amulets and other features, and perhaps you will be able to create your perfect hero.

3) [b]Mob sounds[/b]. We have introduced the voices of elite mobs into the game, which voice their appearance, damage and death. Now, no major opponent will go unnoticed. Based on the sounds of damage, you will be able to select the most effective combinations of weapons and equipment, and also do not miss the opportunity to get large experience crystals after defeating the monster.

4) [b]Portraits of characters[/b]. Our artist added new portraits of characters from ancient myths to the game, but at the same time reinterpreted their images in his own way. Leave a comment: does your vision of the Greek gods match what you have encountered in our game?

5) [b]English version[/b]. We have improved the English version of our game and fixed some minor bugs.
🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️🏛⚡️
P.S. We hope that with each update our game becomes more high-quality and exciting.
